entities.name: TGFBR2 (sequence match)
observations: The 598-aa query matches reviewed human TGFBR2 at 50.4% identity over 89.6% of the query (E=2.98e-192); Pfam detects the extracellular TGF-beta receptor domain and protein kinase domains.
Reference TGFBR2 is a single-pass plasma-membrane serine/threonine kinase receptor for TGFB1, TGFB2, and TGFB3; it activates TGFBR1, which then signals through SMAD2/SMAD3 and SMAD4.
Reference localization includes the cell surface/plasma membrane, membrane rafts, and extracellular-facing receptor region.

Associated biology includes TGF-beta signaling, cell-cycle arrest, mesenchymal proliferation and differentiation, wound healing, extracellular-matrix production, immunoregulation, and development-related signaling. These are reference annotations, not independently demonstrated for the query.

entities.name: TGF-beta signaling
observations: TGFBR2 initiates canonical signaling by activating TGFBR1; activated TGFBR1 phosphorylates SMAD2/3, which partner with SMAD4 to regulate transcription. TGFBR2 also participates in noncanonical signaling.
